"Our school library has 6,000 books, but 40 percent of them are more than fifteen years old. Last year, 300 students borrowed more than ten books each. Some say we cannot afford a new library. But can we afford to let our dreams gather dust? Vote for a new library, and vote for our future."
x-e-h3-02.thinking.1: Ukwahlulela ukuthi yimuphi ulwazi inombolo edinga ukuba nencazelo
x-e-h3-02.thinking.2: Ukuhlola ukuthi okuthile kuphendula inkulumo ephikisayo yini
x-e-h3-02.s.s1.prompt: Khetha zonke izitatimende 'ezingahlolwa kusetshenziswa ulwazi olusenkulumweni kuphela.'
x-e-h3-02.s.s1.hint.0: Kuzitatimende ngasinye, thola ukuthi yimuphi umusho enkulumweni osisho.
x-e-h3-02.s.s1.hint.1: Hlukanisa lokho ongakuthola ngokubala ezinombolweni nesicelo sokugcina.
x-e-h3-02.s.s1.r.a: Lesi sitatimende siqamba bese sengeza okuqukethwe okungekho enkulumweni. Udinga ukuhlukanisa ulwazi olusenkulumweni neziqagelo zakho.
x-e-h3-02.s.s1.r.b: Lesi sitatimende ongasihlola kunombolo, 40 percent ka-6,000.
x-e-h3-02.s.s1.r.c: Lesi yisicelo sokugcina senkulumo, hhayi ulwazi oluqinisekisiwe. Kungenzeka ufunde ulwazi nesicelo ndawonye.
x-e-h3-02.s.s1.r.d: Ungakuhlola lokhu kusuka ku-'300 students borrowed more than ten books each.'
x-e-h3-02.s.s1.r.e: Inkulumo ayiphenduli udaba lezindleko. Uma uyifunde sengathi iphendula inkulumo ephikisayo, uzokhetha lokhu.
x-e-h3-02.s.s1.explain: b (cishe izincwadi ezindala ezingu-2,400) no-d (abanye abafundi baboleke kakhulu) kungahlolwa ngezinombolo. c no-e kuthenjiswa noma kukhonjwa kuphela yinkulumo ngaphandle kobufakazi, futhi a ayikho enkulumweni.
x-e-h3-02.s.s2.prompt: Ukwahlulela ukuthi '300 students borrowed more than ten books each' siqinile kangakanani njengobufakazi bokuthi abafundi abaningi basebenzisa ithala lezincwadi, udinga kakhulu ini?
x-e-h3-02.s.s2.hint.0: Cabanga ukuthi yisiphi isilinganiso esenza inombolo engu-300 izwakale inkulu.
x-e-h3-02.s.s2.hint.1: Qhathanisa umbono abafundi abafanayo abangu-300 abawunikezayo esikoleni sabafundi abangu-400 nesikoleni sabangu-3,000.
x-e-h3-02.s.s2.r.a: Inani eliphelele lokuboleka liyasiza, kodwa usengakwazi ukusho ukuthi abangu-300 bayiphesenti elingakanani labo bonke abafundi.
x-e-h3-02.s.s2.r.b: Ungahlulela ukuthi inombolo engu-300 inkulu kangakanani uma uyiqhathanisa nenani eliphelele lebafundi.
x-e-h3-02.s.s2.r.c: Amahora okuvula ulwazi ngokuthula, futhi alinakho ukwenza nokuthi 300 inombolo enkulu yini.
x-e-h3-02.s.s2.explain: Udinga ukwazi ukuthi abangu-300 bayiphesenti elingakanani labo bonke abafundi ukwahlulela ukuthi 'bafundi abaningi' yini. Inombolo inencazelo kuphela uma kunento ongayiqhathanisa nayo.
x-e-h3-02.s.s3.prompt: Ingabe u-"But can we afford to let our dreams gather dust?" wenkulumo waphendula inkulumo ephikisayo yokuthi 'we cannot afford a new library'? Bhala imisho engu-1-2 ngesiNgisi.
x-e-h3-02.s.s3.hint.0: Qala ubhale emshweni owodwa ukuthi inkulumo ephikisayo yayiyini.
x-e-h3-02.s.s3.hint.1: Bheka futhi inkulumo ukubona ukuthi umbuzo unikeza izinombolo noma izindlela mayelana nezindleko yini.
x-e-h3-02.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ingabe usho ngokucacile 'ukuthi inkulumo ephikisayo yayiyini' empendulweni yakho?
x-e-h3-02.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ingabe ugwemile ukuqamba amaqiniso angekho enkulumweni lapho uhlola?

x-e-h3-04.title: Amaqiniso afanayo, abafundi ababili: ukuhlunga amagama okwahlulela nokubhala kabusha
x-e-h3-04.goal: Hlukanisa amaqiniso nokuhlola emshweni oxutshe ukwahlulela, bese uwubhala kabusha ngesiNgisi kubafundi abahlukile: indaba engathathi hlangothi yewebhusayithi yesikole nesaziso sabazali.
x-e-h3-04.material:
Iphephandaba lesikole lashicilela lo musho. "The principal's harsh new rule steals students' phones every morning, and parents are rightly angry."
Amaqiniso anje. Kusukela ngoMashi 4, abafundi babeka amafoni abo ebhokisini lokugcina ngo-8:30 a.m. futhi bawathola emuva ngo-3:30 p.m. Iqembu elilodwa labazali lacela isikole ukuthi sibuyekeze umthetho. Isikole sachaza ukuthi umthetho wokusiza abafundi ukuthi bagxile eklasini.
x-e-h3-04.prereq.1: Isipiliyoni sokubona uhlaka oluyisisekelo lwe-imeyili noma isaziso sesiNgisi
x-e-h3-04.s.s1.prompt: Khetha zonke izisho emshweni ongenhla eziqukethe 'isinqumo somlobi,' hhayi 'amaqiniso.'
x-e-h3-04.s.s1.hint.0: Hlola ukuthi amaqiniso (yini, nini) ahlala efana noma ususa leli gama.
x-e-h3-04.s.s1.hint.1: Zihlele ngokuthi 'ingaqinisekiswa yinoma ubani, noma kungukuhlola komuntu othile?'

x-e-h3-04.s.s1.r.c: Lokhu kuchaza isikhathi abafundi abanikeza ngaso amafoni abo, ngakho kusondele kuqiniso.
x-e-h3-04.s.s1.r.d: U-'Steals' ukuhlola okuqhathanisa ukugcina amafoni nokweba.
x-e-h3-04.s.s1.r.e: U-'Rightly angry' isisho lapho umlobi enquma ukuthi ulaka luyafaneleka.
x-e-h3-04.s.s1.explain: U-Harsh, steals no-rightly angry bathwala ukuhlola komlobi, hhayi amaqiniso. U-New rule no-every morning yizincazelo.
x-e-h3-04.s.s2.prompt: Bhala umusho oyindaba engathathi hlangothi ngesiNgisi wewebhusayithi yesikole. Kumele ufake amaqiniso (isikhathi, amafoni, isicelo sabazali) futhi ushiye amagama okwahlulela.
x-e-h3-04.s.s2.hint.0: Faka elinye lamaqiniso amathathu anikeziwe emshweni wakho eyodwa ngesikhathi.
x-e-h3-04.s.s2.hint.1: Susa amagama okuhlola emshweni wokuqala, bese ugcwalisa amaqiniso kuhlaka oluseleyo.
x-e-h3-04.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ingabe uhlolé eyodwa ngesikhathi ukuthi 'amaqiniso angaqinisekiswa yinoma ubani' kuphela asele emshweni wakho?
x-e-h3-04.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ingabe uhlolé ukuthi isichasiso esibukeka sihloniphisa njengo-'strict' siqukethe isinqumo yini?
x-e-h3-04.s.s3.prompt: Kulesi sikhathi, bhala okuqukethwe okufanayo ngesiNgisi njengesaziso sabazali. Qala ngenhlonipho futhi ufake isizathu sesikole.
x-e-h3-04.s.s3.hint.0: Qala unqume ukuthi yini abazali abayofisa kakhulu ukuyazi.
x-e-h3-04.s.s3.hint.1: Engeza umusho ochaza isizathu sesikole ngemva kwemisho yamaqiniso.
x-e-h3-04.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Yini eshintshile uma kuqhathaniswa nendaba yewebhusayithi (ukubingelela, izisho ezithambile, isizathu)?
x-e-h3-04.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ngenkathi wengeza izisho ezihloniphayo, ingabe ugcine amaqiniso (izikhathi, usuku lokuqala)?
x-e-h3-04.s.s3.modelNote.2: Iqukethe uhlobo oluhloniphayo lokubiza, amaqiniso, nesizathu sesikole.

x-e-h3-05.prereq.1: Imisho elula yesiNgisi mayelana nemiphumela yocwaningo
x-e-h3-05.s.s1.prompt: Yini okumele uyihlole kuqala ngaphambi kokukholwa yisicelo sika-Jun?

x-e-h3-05.s.s1.hint.1: Cabanga ukuthi iyiphi indlela yocwaningo eyenza umphumela ofanayo unzima ukuyikholwa.

x-e-h3-05.s.s1.r.d: Ukuqhathanisa nonyaka odlule kubheka ushintsho, kodwa akusitsheli ukuthi lolu cwaningo lwethenjwa yini.
x-e-h3-05.s.s1.explain: Ukuthi umphumela umele sonke isikole yini kuncike enanini nasendleleni yokukhetha yabantu ababuziwe. Awukwazi ukusho ngeqiniso lokuthi iphesenti liphezulu.

Yenza amacala amabili anosayizi bocwaningo abahlukile (n). (n = inani labafundi ababuziwe, y = bangaki phakathi kwabo abathe bayathanda, r = bangaki phakathi kwabafundi abasele ababengabuziwe abathanda ngempela.
